svg.title: Multiple soft-frames
svg.desc: Left: a single soft-frame computed by shape matching over the whole soft-body, with one joint attached at its center. Right: two clusters of mass points, each with its own soft-frame whose position and orientation follow the local deformation, each with its own joint.
svg.text: One soft-frame for the whole body

g.text: The whole body gets a single position and orientation,
Each cluster gets its own position and orientation,
shape-matched on its own subset of mass points.
